visual_lenses.title: Adapter Resolver
visual_lenses.summary: Axios adapter architecture: three adapters (xhr, http, fetch) selected via getAdapter resolver in lib/adapters/adapters.js, invoked by dispatchRequest.js
visual_lenses.simple_explanation: Axios picks the right network transport (browser XHR, Node.js HTTP, or Fetch API) automatically based on the environment, or you can specify one explicitly in config. The selection logic lives in lib/adapters/adapters.js and the actual request dispatch in lib/core/dispatchRequest.js.
visual_lenses.technical_explanation: dispatchRequest.js calls adapters.getAdapter(config.adapter || defaults.adapter, config) to resolve the adapter. getAdapter in lib/adapters/adapters.js accepts a string name, a function, or an array of candidates, iterating until a supported adapter is found. Platform defaults (lib/defaults/index.js) set the fallback order. The three concrete adapters are lib/adapters/xhr.js (browser XMLHttpRequest), lib/adapters/http.js (Node.js http/https), and lib/adapters/fetch.js (Fetch API). Each adapter returns a Promise<response>. dispatchRequest then applies request/response transforms and cancellation checks around the adapter call.

visual_lenses.title: Adapter Resolver
visual_lenses.summary: Axios adapter architecture: three adapters (xhr, http, fetch) selected via getAdapter resolver in lib/adapters/adapters.js, invoked by dispatchRequest.js
visual_lenses.simple_explanation: Axios picks the right network transport (browser XHR, Node.js HTTP, or Fetch API) automatically based on the environment, or you can specify one explicitly in config. The selection logic lives in lib/adapters/adapters.js and the actual request dispatch in lib/core/dispatchRequest.js.
visual_lenses.technical_explanation: dispatchRequest.js calls adapters.getAdapter(config.adapter || defaults.adapter, config) to resolve the adapter. getAdapter in lib/adapters/adapters.js accepts a string name, a function, or an array of candidates, iterating until a supported adapter is found. Platform defaults (lib/defaults/index.js) set the fallback order. The three concrete adapters are lib/adapters/xhr.js (browser XMLHttpRequest), lib/adapters/http.js (Node.js http/https), and lib/adapters/fetch.js (Fetch API). Each adapter returns a Promise<response>. dispatchRequest then applies request/response transforms and cancellation checks around the adapter call.
